scene_summary: An abstract rose optical field in poster crop, front-facing optical superimposition with separated focal planes and a displaced foreground veil. Split photographic residues into an upper-left brow-and-eye mass and a smaller lower-right mouth-and-cheek mass across broad plum-charcoal silence. Doubled lavender rails cross the first, rupture, then resume sideways; an oversized loop straddles the break. Two expansive apertures dominate; six smaller rail breaks, contour openings and a detached mottled diagonal punctuate quiet pockets. Blush exposure, violet overlaps, soft streaked edges; no complete face, text or symbols.
